g.text: A reader next to a writer that fsyncs every 4K write. Without PLP the drive must program its buffer before

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5f6b73

g.text: answering the flush, and a SATA flush holds up everything queued behind it.
